mentions.name: Sensonym
mentions.description: A language learning app that teaches vocabulary through physical phone interactions, mapping words to sensor-driven actions—nearly 40 interaction types using the accelerometer, gyroscope, camera face detection, and microphone (e.g., shake the phone for "earthquake," blow on it for "wind," smile for "happiness"). Built with React Native/Expo and live in German app stores.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on Sensonym (https://sensonym.com), a language learning app that teaches vocabulary through physical phone interactions. Shake your phone to learn "earthquake," blow on it for "wind," smile for "happiness." Nearly 40 different interaction types using accelerometer, gyroscope, camera face detection, microphone, etc.
